## ERROR REPORTING

Only report errors that appear right after executing the Seisen Hub script — some red errors come from the game itself.

## SCRIPT / KEY SYSTEM NOT WORKING

**Step 1 — Check the console for errors.**

- **PC:** Press **F9**
- **Mobile:** Type **/console** in the Roblox chat

If a red error appears right after executing, screenshot it and post it in [bug-reports](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1521488024972820520).

**Step 2 — No console errors? Try a VPN.**

If there are no errors but the key system or script still does not open, the issue may be your internet connection or a country-based GitHub restriction. This is common in countries like **Germany** and **Russia**. Fix:

1. Download a VPN (e.g. **Warp VPN** or any free VPN).
2. Switch to a different region.
3. Check that **https://github.com** loads in your browser.
4. Re-execute the script.

**Step 3 — Still not working? Check your executor.**

If the VPN does not help, the problem is likely your executor's compatibility level. This is common with **Solara** and **Xeno**.

Compatibility reference:
- **Solara:** SUNC 39% / UNC 67%
- **Xeno:** SUNC 32% / UNC 82%
- **Potassium:** SUNC 100% / UNC 99%

Because Seisen Library requires high UNC/SUNC support, Solara and Xeno may not run it reliably. Switching to a more capable executor resolves this in most cases. Full list: [Supported Executors](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1556707401925918730)

## KEY ISSUES

**"Key limit" - reset HWID:**
Handle this error before the expired/invalid-key guidance below. A "key limit" message requires an HWID reset; do not call the key expired or tell the user to generate, buy, or replace the key for this error.

- **Free key:** Reset HWID in the [get-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1434064472695246858) Discord channel. Free-key HWID resets are available **once per day**.
- **Premium key:** Reset HWID in the [premium-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1421560929425817662) Discord channel.
- If the key type is unknown, give both reset routes. State the once-per-day limit only for free keys; no premium reset frequency is specified here.

**"DISCORD_REDEEM_REQUIRED" error:**
Handle this error before the expired/invalid-key guidance. The key has not been redeemed yet. Redeem it in [get-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1434064472695246858) first — the key cannot be activated until it is redeemed there. Do not tell the user to generate a new key or reset HWID for this error.

**Key expired:**
Free keys expire after a set period. Go to [get-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1434064472695246858) and click **Get Key** again.

**Key not accepted / invalid key:**
- Paste the full key with no extra spaces.
- Keys are case-sensitive — copy and paste, do not type it.
- If the key was generated more than 24 hours ago, it may have expired. Get a new one from [get-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1434064472695246858).

**Key system not appearing after executing the script:**
This is a script load issue, not a key issue. Follow **Script / Key System Not Working** above.

**Premium key not working:**
- Redeem it in the correct channel: [premium-script](https://discord.com/channels/1333251917098520628/1421560929425817662).
- If you purchased and the key was not delivered, contact staff with your payment proof.

## SCRIPT SETTINGS / SAVING CONFIGS

Every Seisen Hub script has a built-in **config manager** in its menu. Type a name in **Config Name**, then use **Create Config** to save your current settings and **Load Config** to restore them. **Account Autoload** or the autoload buttons load a chosen config automatically each time. Many scripts also have an auto-save setting.

Saved settings are stored in a folder inside your executor's **Workspace** folder. Deleting that folder resets your settings.

There is no separate settings list to copy from Discord. The features each script offers are listed in the GAME SCRIPT FEATURES section below.
